Item O:Berlin Tablet (Boomerang)

This tablet is one of the largest, and is in very poor condition. Barthel's tracings include 7 lines. Fischer was able to identify more glyphs on this tablet, including two more lines. I have renumbered Barthel's lines in accordance with Fischer's.

Only one side legible
